task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to the FRONT_CRATE and pick it up to clear the obstacle, then navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE and pick it, then navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE and place the bottle on it.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of CAR and must be removed first.
Robot CAR is able to pick and place objects within its interaction distance.
The locations and objects are static during execution.
